title: Calculus
description: Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals, and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

puzzle.goal: The slope of a curve at a point is what the slope of a short chord approaches as the chord shrinks. For the power function x^n, write the slope at x as the limit of rise over run as the step δ goes to zero.
puzzle.name: Derivative as a limit (power rule)
puzzle.form: lim ( δ , 0 , ( ( x + δ ) ^ n - x ^ n ) / δ )
puzzle.ask: Expanding the binomial gives n·x^(n−1). Find the slope for the values given.
puzzle.method: Take the change in the function over a small step, divide by the step, and let the step tend to zero.
